title: Un consiglio da amici
summary: Giving advice with devi/dovresti and the perché non…? suggestion pattern

blocks.title: Devi o dovresti?
blocks.body: *Devi* (you must / have to) is strong — an order or a real obligation: *devi andare dal medico*. *Dovresti* is softer — 'you should,' a gentle suggestion: *dovresti riposare*. It's the conditional of *dovere*, a tense you'll meet properly later; for now, reach for *dovresti* whenever you're giving friendly advice, not orders.
blocks.callout: Devi = do it. Dovresti = maybe think about it, friend.

items.en: you have to go to the doctor

pairs.left: *Devi andare dal medico.* — strong, real obligation
pairs.right: *Dovresti andare dal medico.* — softer, a suggestion
pairs.note: Same idea, different force — dovresti leaves room to say no.

blocks.prompt: A friend mentions a mild headache. Which sounds like friendly advice, not an order?
blocks.explain: *Dovresti* is the gentle-suggestion register — perfect for a small ache, not orders.
*Dovresti riposare* — the softer 'should', not the blunt 'must'.

blocks.title: Perché non…?
blocks.body: Another everyday way to suggest something: **Perché non + present tense?** — literally 'why not', used just like the English suggestion. *Perché non vai dal medico?* (Why don't you go to the doctor?), *Perché non bevi un tè caldo?* (Why don't you have a hot tea?).
blocks.callout: Perché non…? — same shape as English 'why don't you…?'

blocks.speak: Perché non bevi un tè caldo?
answers: perché non bevi un tè caldo
perché non bevi un tè caldo?

blocks.scene: 'You' mention feeling run down at the bar — Marco gives advice, blunt then softened

lines.speaker: You
lines.nl: Marco, sono stanco e ho mal di testa da due giorni.
lines.en: Marco, I'm tired and I've had a headache for two days.

lines.speaker: Marco
lines.nl: Due giorni? Devi andare dal medico, dai.
lines.en: Two days? You have to go to the doctor, come on.

lines.speaker: Marco
lines.nl: Boh, magari. Comunque dovresti almeno riposare un po' stasera.
lines.en: Well, maybe. Anyway you should at least rest a bit tonight.
lines.spotlight: Marco's blunt devi softens into dovresti one line later — very him.

lines.speaker: Marco
lines.nl: E perché non bevi meno caffè per un paio di giorni, eh?
lines.en: And why don't you drink less coffee for a couple of days, eh?

questions.q: How long has 'You' had a headache?
What does Marco suggest besides resting?

blocks.prompt: Pensa a un amico o un'amica stanco/a o stressato/a. Scrivi 3 consigli usando devi, dovresti o perché non…?
